shots.scene: 欣欣手里捧着一个发光的小灯泡，站在人体轮廓挂图旁
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a small glowing light bulb and stands beside a large poster with a simple human body outline.
shots.narration: 这一课，我们走进核医学。
overlay: 核医学入门：把“小灯泡”送进身体

shots.scene: 人体轮廓里一个器官微微发光，体外一圈小方块接收光点
shots.prompt_en: A simple human body outline with one organ glowing softly inside, surrounded by a ring of small blank detector blocks catching light dots. No people.
shots.narration: 把光源放进身体，从外面看里面。

shots.scene: 老周坐在办公室，手捂肚子，桌上放着一张空白检查预约单
shots.prompt_en: The older man sits at his office desk holding his stomach with a worried face, a blank appointment slip on the desk.
shots.narration: 老周胃不舒服，医生约了核医学检查。

shots.scene: 阿杰瞪大眼睛看着预约单上的电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stares wide-eyed at the blank appointment slip, which shows a small ionizing radiation warning sign.
shots.narration: 阿杰吓一跳：要吃放射性的东西？

shots.scene: 小研笑着走过来，拿着一个空白文件夹
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student walks over smiling, holding a blank folder.
shots.narration: 小研在核医学实验室做课题。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在三人中间，举起一根手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands between the older man, the young male student and the female graduate student, raising one finger.
shots.narration: 别慌，先弄懂它的道理。

shots.scene: 左边是探测器和谱仪图标，右边是人形图标，中间箭头
shots.prompt_en: On the left a detector and spectrometer icon, on the right a simple human figure icon, with an arrow pointing from left to right. No people.
shots.narration: 之前学的是辐射怎样打进探测器。

shots.scene: 探测器读数指向一个发光的原子核图标
shots.prompt_en: A detector reading icon points back to a glowing atomic nucleus icon, like tracing footprints to their owner. No people.
shots.narration: 测辐射，是为了认识发出它的源。

shots.scene: 小研在实验室操作台旁戴着剂量计工作
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student works at a lab bench wearing a lab coat, gloves and a personal dosimeter badge.
shots.narration: 可做实验时，人也站在辐射旁边。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着人形图标上方的问号
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a question mark floating above a simple human figure icon.
shots.narration: 所以要问：辐射对人有什么影响？

shots.scene: 四级台阶上依次亮起能量、放大镜、人体、器官图标
shots.prompt_en: Four glowing steps light up one by one with icons: an energy bolt, a magnifying glass, a human body outline and several organ icons. No people.
shots.narration: 衡量受照，前面学过几把尺子。

shots.scene: 同样大小的能量球落在不同器官上，器官亮度不同
shots.prompt_en: Identical small energy balls fall onto different organ icons, and each organ glows with a different brightness. No people.
shots.narration: 同样的能量，落在不同器官效果不同。

shots.scene: 三种不同形状的射线箭头，打在同一块组织上留下不同痕迹
shots.prompt_en: Three different kinds of ray arrows hit the same tissue block and leave different sized marks. No people.
shots.narration: 射线种类和能量不同，效果也不同。

shots.scene: 欣欣翻过一页理论书，拿起听诊器图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot closes a thick theory book and picks up a stethoscope icon.
shots.narration: 今天换个角度：辐射怎样帮医生看病。

shots.scene: 老周躺在诊床上，一位医生图标按压他的腹部
shots.prompt_en: The older man lies on an examination couch while a simple doctor pictogram gently presses on his abdomen.
shots.narration: 老周先去看医生，医生按了按肚子。

shots.scene: 桌上一盒空白药盒，日历翻过三天，老周仍然皱眉
shots.prompt_en: A blank medicine box on a table, a calendar flipping three pages, and the older man still frowning and holding his stomach.
shots.narration: 吃了几天药，还是没好转。

shots.scene: 一扇关着的人体轮廓“门”，门上画着眼睛和问号
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline drawn like a closed door, with an eye icon and a question mark on it. No people.
shots.narration: 医生想：要是能看到里面就好了。

shots.section_title: X射线：穿过越多，剩下越少
shots.scene: 一束X射线箭头从左边射向人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: A bundle of arrows comes from a box-shaped X-ray tube icon on the left toward a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 最常见的办法，是拍X光片。
overlay: X射线：穿过越多，剩下越少

shots.section_title: X射线：穿过越多，剩下越少
shots.scene: 一排光子小球穿过几层纱帘，每过一层少一些
shots.prompt_en: A row of bright photon balls passes through several layers of thin curtains, and fewer balls come out after each layer. No people.
shots.narration: 光子穿过物质，一层层被拦下一部分。

shots.section_title: X射线：穿过越多，剩下越少
shots.scene: 薄纱帘后剩下很多小球，厚毯子后只剩几个
shots.prompt_en: Behind a thin curtain many balls remain; behind a thick blanket only a few balls remain. No people.
shots.narration: 越厚、越难穿透，剩下的就越少。

shots.section_title: X射线：穿过越多，剩下越少
shots.scene: 欣欣比划一条越来越低的滑梯曲线
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot traces a smooth slide-shaped curve in the air that drops quickly and then levels off.
shots.narration: 这种减少，是按比例一路递减的。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓内分成肌肉、器官、骨骼三种颜色区域
shots.prompt_en: A human body outline divided into three colored regions: soft muscle, organs and hard bones. No people.
shots.narration: 人体有肌肉、器官和骨头。

shots.scene: 三扇不同厚度的“门”，挡住光子的多少不同
shots.prompt_en: Three gates of different thickness block different numbers of photon balls: a light gate, a medium gate and a heavy gate. No people.
shots.narration: 它们拦光子的本领各不相同。

shots.scene: 穿过人体后的光子落在胶片上，形成一幅空白轮廓的黑白图
shots.prompt_en: Photon balls that pass through the body land on a blank film, forming a black and white shadow picture of bones and soft tissue. No people.
shots.narration: 穿过来的多少不同，就成了影像。

shots.scene: 胶片上骨头处白、软组织处暗，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: On the film the bones appear white and the soft tissue appears dark, with a green check mark beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 骨头拦得多显白，软组织显暗。

shots.scene: 射线源在人体外面，箭头从外面照进来
shots.prompt_en: A ray source icon sits outside a human body outline and arrows shine in from outside. No people.
shots.narration: X射线的源，放在身体外面。

shots.scene: 胃部区域一片模糊灰色，旁边一个问号
shots.prompt_en: The stomach area on a shadow picture is a blurry grey patch with a question mark next to it. No people.
shots.narration: 软组织的毛病，有时看不清楚。

shots.scene: 欣欣把箭头从“外”拨向“内”
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot flips a direction sign from pointing outward to pointing inward.
shots.narration: 能不能换成从里面往外看？

shots.scene: 一把手术刀图标和人体轮廓，中间一条虚线
shots.prompt_en: A scalpel icon next to a human body outline with a dashed line on the abdomen. No people.
shots.narration: 一种办法是开刀，直接看。

shots.scene: 侵入式图标旁边一个天平，一边是创伤，一边是信息
shots.prompt_en: Beside the scalpel icon, a balance scale weighs a bandage icon against an information icon. No people.
shots.narration: 这叫侵入式，代价是身体受创。

shots.section_title: 把光源放进身体：核医学
shots.scene: 人体轮廓的胃里亮起一个小灯泡
shots.prompt_en: A small light bulb glows inside the stomach of a human body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 另一种办法：把光源放进身体。
overlay: 把光源放进身体：核医学

shots.section_title: 把光源放进身体：核医学
shots.scene: 灯泡发出γ光点，穿出身体，被两侧的小方块接住
shots.prompt_en: The glowing bulb sends out small gamma light dots in all directions; the dots pass out of the body and are caught by blank detector blocks on both sides. No people.
shots.narration: 体内发出γ光子，体外探测器接收。

shots.section_title: 把光源放进身体：核医学
shots.scene: 探测器把光点拼成一幅器官发光图
shots.prompt_en: The detector blocks assemble the caught light dots into a glowing picture of the organ. No people.
shots.narration: 拼起来，就能看到器官的情况。

shots.section_title: 把光源放进身体：核医学
shots.scene: 欣欣举牌，牌上是器官加齿轮图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank sign showing an organ icon with a small turning gear.
shots.narration: 它更擅长看器官“干活”的状态。

shots.section_title: 把光源放进身体：核医学
shots.scene: 欣欣双手一摊，背后亮起人体轮廓
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot opens both arms, and a glowing human body outline lights up behind it.
shots.narration: 这就是核医学。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源
shots.scene: 一颗分成两半的药片图标，左半亮黄，右半亮绿
shots.prompt_en: A tablet icon split into two halves, the left half glowing yellow and the right half glowing green. No people.
shots.narration: 把这个光源比作一颗特别的药。
overlay: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源

shots.section_title: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源
shots.scene: 左半边药片上亮起电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: An ionizing radiation warning sign lights up on the left half of the tablet icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第一部分，是放射性核素。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源
shots.scene: 阿杰双手抱头，老周一脸担心
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his head in disbelief while the older man looks worried.
shots.narration: 病人已经难受，还要用放射性药？

shots.section_title: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源
shots.scene: 欣欣轻拍老周肩膀，旁边天平上获益一侧更重
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot pats the older man on the shoulder; beside them a balance scale tips toward a heart icon on the benefit side.
shots.narration: 可以，剂量经过权衡，获益大于风险。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物第一部分：放射源
shots.scene: 注射器图标和药片图标并排，注射器更大
shots.prompt_en: A syringe icon and a small tablet icon side by side, the syringe icon drawn larger. No people.
shots.narration: 实际上，多数是静脉注射给药。

shots.scene: 一根快速燃烧变短的蜡烛和一根很长的蜡烛
shots.prompt_en: A short candle burning down quickly next to a very long candle burning slowly. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源要选半衰期短的。

shots.scene: 沙漏快速漏完，旁边光点越来越少
shots.prompt_en: An hourglass empties quickly while the number of light dots beside it shrinks fast. No people.
shots.narration: 几个小时内，活度就降下来很多。

shots.scene: 核素主要发出γ光点，β小球很少
shots.prompt_en: A small glowing nucleus icon mainly sends out wavy gamma light dots, with very few other particles. No people.
shots.narration: 最好主要发出γ光子，方便体外接收。

shots.scene: 欣欣比出“短”的手势
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot makes a short-distance gesture with two paws close together.
shots.narration: 发光够用就好，不要长时间留着。

shots.scene: 药片从嘴进入，路径分岔通往胃、肺、心脏
shots.prompt_en: A tablet icon enters through the mouth of a body outline; the path splits toward the stomach, the lungs and the heart, with a question mark. No people.
shots.narration: 进了身体，怎么保证去对地方？

shots.scene: 一辆小快递车载着发光包裹，开向胃的位置
shots.prompt_en: A tiny delivery van carrying a glowing parcel drives along a path straight to the stomach. No people.
shots.narration: 第二部分是载体，像快递员送货。

shots.scene: 快递车停在胃里，包裹留在原处发光，肺和心脏打叉
shots.prompt_en: The van parks in the stomach and the glowing parcel stays there, while the lungs and heart icons beside it are crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 把放射源送到目标，并停留一会儿。

shots.scene: 另一辆快递车沿血管开向肝脏
shots.prompt_en: Another tiny delivery van drives along a blood vessel path toward the liver icon. No people.
shots.narration: 看肝脏等器官，就换别的载体和途径。

shots.scene: 两个打勾的图标：快速变短的蜡烛和一扇出口门
shots.prompt_en: Two icons with green check marks: a quickly burning short candle and an exit door. No people.
shots.narration: 设计药物，记住两件事。

shots.scene: 体内光点一部分自己熄灭，一部分走向出口
shots.prompt_en: Light dots inside a body outline: some fade out by themselves and others move toward an exit arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 一边自己衰变，一边经尿液粪便排出。

shots.scene: 光点长期堆在胃里，变红，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Light dots piling up in the stomach for a long time turn red and are crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要是一直留在体内，就成了隐患。

shots.scene: 一颗普通药丸带出一个小副作用云朵，旁边放射源云朵更大打叉
shots.prompt_en: A normal pill icon with a small side-effect cloud, and next to it a radioactive cloud that is larger and crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 就像药物副作用，而且更要不得。

shots.scene: 老周拿着空白注意事项单点头
shots.prompt_en: The older man holds a blank instruction sheet and nods.
shots.narration: 检查后的注意事项，要听医生的。

shots.scene: 时钟和照相机图标并排，时钟指针在走
shots.prompt_en: A clock icon with moving hands next to a camera icon. No people.
shots.narration: 光源还亮着的这段时间，赶紧采集。

shots.scene: 照相机拍下器官发光图，然后光点熄灭
shots.prompt_en: The camera icon captures a glowing organ picture, then the light dots fade away. No people.
shots.narration: 拍完图像，放射性也逐渐消退。

shots.scene: 欣欣总结：灯泡、快递车、相机三个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at three icons in a row: a light bulb, a delivery van and a camera.
shots.narration: 光源、载体、探测，就是核医学的思路。

shots.scene: 人体轮廓外，单个探测器只接住一侧光点
shots.prompt_en: Outside a body outline, a single detector block catches light dots from only one side, and many dots fly past. No people.
shots.narration: 光子朝四面八方飞，一个探头接不全。

shots.scene: 人体周围一圈探测器，接住所有方向的光点
shots.prompt_en: A full ring of detector blocks surrounds the body outline and catches light dots coming from every direction. No people.
shots.narration: 理想的办法：在身体外围一圈探测器。

shots.scene: 探测器环沿身体上下移动到胃的位置
shots.prompt_en: The detector ring slides up and down along the body outline and stops at the stomach level. No people.
shots.narration: 环可以上下移动，对准要看的部位。

shots.section_title: 环形与圆柱形探测装置
shots.scene: 探测器环接住整个平面的光点，拼成一圈图像
shots.prompt_en: The detector ring collects light dots across the whole plane and builds a cross-section picture of the organ. No people.
shots.narration: 一圈都接住，就能看清整个器官。
overlay: 环形与圆柱形探测装置

shots.section_title: 环形与圆柱形探测装置
shots.scene: 老周躺在检查床上，床缓缓移入一个空白圆筒形设备
shots.prompt_en: The older man lies calmly on a scanner bed that slowly slides into a blank cylindrical imaging machine.
shots.narration: 医院里，病人躺着随床移进圆筒。

shots.section_title: 环形与圆柱形探测装置
shots.scene: 圆筒里是一圈圈探测器环的剖面示意
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway view of the cylinder shows many stacked rings of detector blocks inside. No people.
shots.narration: 圆筒里，就是一圈圈的探测器。

shots.section_title: 环形与圆柱形探测装置
shots.scene: 一个可绕身体转动的平板探头图标
shots.prompt_en: A flat detector head icon rotates slowly around a body outline. No people.
shots.narration: 也有会转动的探头，从多个角度拍。

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 小研在实验室门口，从外包装上贴有电离辐射警告标志的屏蔽包装箱旁核对空白单据
shots.prompt_en: At the lab entrance, the female graduate student checks a blank delivery form next to a sealed shielded package box that has an ionizing radiation warning sign on it.
shots.narration: 放射性药品，要从有资质的单位购买。
overlay: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 小研对照空白单据看包装箱，旁边勾选框图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares the package label area with the blank form, with checkbox icons beside her.
shots.narration: 到货先验收：核素、活度、数量对单据。

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 小研用表面污染监测仪扫包装箱外表
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves scans the outside of the package with a handheld contamination monitor.
shots.narration: 再测包装外表面，有无破损和污染。

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 上锁的专用储存柜，柜门有电离辐射警告标志
shots.prompt_en: A locked dedicated storage cabinet with an ionizing radiation warning sign on its door. No people.
shots.narration: 入库放专用柜，加锁，专人管理。

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 小研和王老师在空白台账本上签字
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student and the safety administrator sign in a blank logbook at the storage room.
shots.narration: 领用登记签字，账物要一一对应。

shots.section_title: 放射性药品：采购验收与台账
shots.scene: 欣欣举着空白法规书本图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a blank rule book with a gavel icon on its cover.
shots.narration: 具体要求，以现行法规和本校规定为准。

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 屏蔽罐里的发生器，像一头“母牛”图标
shots.prompt_en: A shielded generator column icon drawn like a friendly cow being milked, with an ionizing radiation warning sign on it. No people.
shots.narration: 有些核素用发生器现场“挤”出来。
overlay: 发生器的安全使用与归还

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 老李检查到货的发生器屏蔽外壳，戴手套和剂量计
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wearing gloves and a dosimeter badge inspects the outer shielding of a delivered generator.
shots.narration: 到货查外壳完好，登记入账。

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 发生器放在屏蔽墙后，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: The generator sits behind a shielding wall inside a fume hood, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 在屏蔽区内使用，按规程操作。

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 空白标签贴在屏蔽容器上，旁边时钟图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank label is stuck on a small shielded container, next to a clock icon and a pen. No people.
shots.narration: 每次取出的药液，都要标签和记录。

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 拆开的发生器和扳手图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: A dismantled generator with a wrench icon, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得自行拆解发生器。

shots.section_title: 发生器的安全使用与归还
shots.scene: 发生器装回原包装，交还给快递车，普通垃圾桶打叉
shots.prompt_en: The generator is packed back into its original shielded box and handed to a delivery van, while an ordinary trash bin beside it is crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 用完按约定退回供应单位，不当垃圾扔。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 台面上一小摊液体，阿杰手里的小瓶倾倒
shots.prompt_en: A small vial tips over on a lab bench tray and a small puddle spreads; the young male student, wearing gloves, steps back.
shots.narration: 放射性药液洒了，先别慌。
overlay: 放射性药物洒了怎么办

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 阿杰抬手喊人，小研拉起警戒带
shots.prompt_en: The young male student raises his hand to call out while the female graduate student puts up barrier tape around the bench.
shots.narration: 立刻告诉旁人，围起区域，别让人踩。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 徒手擦拭和冲进水槽的图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Two icons crossed out with red X marks: a bare hand wiping a puddle, and liquid being washed into a sink. No people.
shots.narration: 不能徒手擦，不能冲进下水道。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 吸水纸从外圈向中心覆盖液体
shots.prompt_en: Absorbent paper sheets cover the puddle, placed from the outer edge toward the center, with arrows showing the direction. No people.
shots.narration: 戴手套用吸水纸，从外向内吸附。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 用过的纸放进带电离辐射警告标志的专用废物袋
shots.prompt_en: Used absorbent paper goes into a dedicated waste bag marked with an ionizing radiation warning sign. No people.
shots.narration: 用过的材料，放进放射性废物袋。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 小研用表面污染监测仪检查台面和阿杰的手套、鞋底
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student uses a handheld contamination monitor to check the bench, the young male student's gloves and shoe soles.
shots.narration: 监测台面和人身，确认没有残留。

shots.section_title: 放射性药物洒了怎么办
shots.scene: 阿杰拿手机向老周报告，旁边空白记录表
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reports by phone to the older man, with a blank incident record sheet on the bench.
shots.narration: 报告负责人，记录经过；沾到皮肤要说。

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 活度计图标和空白读数屏
shots.prompt_en: A dose calibrator well icon with a blank reading screen and a small shielded vial lowered into it. No people.
shots.narration: 药品使用前，要做质量控制。
overlay: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 测量值与处方单比对，打勾
shots.prompt_en: A blank measurement display and a blank prescription sheet linked by an equal sign with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 活度要实测，和处方一致。

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 屏蔽注射器套上贴着空白标签，标签旁图标：原子、天平、时钟、人像
shots.prompt_en: A shielded syringe holder with a blank label, surrounded by four icons: an atom, a balance, a clock and a person silhouette. No people.
shots.narration: 标签写清核素、活度、时间和对象。

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 两位穿白大衣的人形图标一起核对标签和腕带
shots.prompt_en: Two staff pictograms in white coats check a syringe label and a patient wristband together, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 给药前两人核对：人、药、量都对上。

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 两支外形相同的屏蔽注射器，其中一支被拿错打叉
shots.prompt_en: Two identical shielded syringes side by side; a hand picking the wrong one is crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 外形一样的容器，最容易拿错。

shots.section_title: 质控与标签核对，防止给错药
shots.scene: 空白报告单和向上箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: A blank report form with an upward arrow toward a building icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一旦给错，立即报告并按规定处理。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在发光人体挂图前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of the glowing human body poster.
shots.narration: 今天的内容，回顾一下。

shots.scene: X射线从外照进来、灯泡从里往外亮，两个图标对比
shots.prompt_en: Two icons compared: rays shining into a body from outside, and a light bulb glowing out from inside a body. No people.
shots.narration: X光从外照，核医学从里往外看。

shots.scene: 药片两半：放射源和快递车
shots.prompt_en: A two-half tablet icon: a glowing radioactive source half and a tiny delivery van half. No people.
shots.narration: 放射源加载体，送到目标器官。

shots.scene: 短蜡烛和出口门打勾
shots.prompt_en: A short burning candle and an exit door, both with green check marks. No people.
shots.narration: 衰变快、排出快，才不留隐患。

shots.scene: 探测器环和圆筒设备图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a detector ring and a cylindrical scanner. No people.
shots.narration: 体外一圈探测器，拼出器官图像。

shots.scene: 台账本、发生器、吸水纸、标签四个图标打勾
shots.prompt_en: Four icons with green check marks: a logbook, a shielded generator, absorbent paper and a label. No people.
shots.narration: 台账、发生器、溢洒、核对，样样要管好。

shots.scene: 欣欣和老周、阿杰、小研一起挥手道别，老周笑着
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye together with the smiling older man, the young male student and the female graduate student.
shots.narration: 懂原理，守规矩，下次课见！
